sub_site: plasma (breast cancer cases vs healthy controls)

evidence.quote: We performed 16S rRNA gene sequencing and metabolomics profiling on blood samples from 107 breast cancer cases and 107 age-paired controls
Variable regions V3–V4 of the bacterial 16S rRNA gene were amplified

controls.types: extraction water blank; PCR/library-prep water NTC

evidence.quote: sterile DNA-free water was used as a negative control in PCR amplification and sequencing library preparation for subsequent identification of reagent contaminants
by the prevalence of each ASV in blood samples compared to the prevalence in negative controls
We identified and removed potential contaminants using the decontam package (v.1.2.1)

notes: 48 LEfSe-differential genera shown in Fig. 2; text names a subset. Ranking only top-3 per group (cases: Ralstonia, Methyloversatilis, Bifidobacterium; controls: Aeribacillus, Thermincola, Ralstonia), so top5 left empty. Pseudomonas/Sphingomonas/Cutibacterium named in Discussion as own LEfSe results. Number of negative controls sequenced not stated. No supplements available.
